title: Kissed Umami Japanese Sausage Skewers
description: A crumbly, savory Japanese dish featuring German sausages marinated in miso, perfect for a date night, with a macrobiotic-friendly twist.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, soy sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, sesame oil, grated ginger, garlic powder, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the German sausages to the marinade and toss to coat evenly, letting them marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread one sausage onto each bamboo skewer, leaving a small space between each sausage.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until the sausages are cooked through and slightly charred.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with sliced green onions and toasted sesame seeds if desired.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
Serve with a side of steamed vegetables or a salad for a well-rounded meal.
